basic_profile.bio: Living in the bustling city of Toronto, I am a 31-year-old chartered accountant by profession, with a strong interest in technology and metallurgy. I enjoy helping others, particularly in understanding complex financial topics. In my free time, I often dive into PC building and audio equipment. My online presence is mostly during late evenings after work hours, and during weekends. I'm currently single, focusing on career growth and personal development.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Accounting and Finance and have been working in the field for over 8 years. My interest in technology is self-taught, fueled by countless hours of reading forums and experimenting with hardware. I also have a budding interest in metallurgy, which I explore through online courses and community discussions.
